answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed for fraud, and let reputation grow only from repeated, checkable work that cannot be copied to a new account. Like a river carving one channel over time, trust should accumulate slowly, so cloning a trusted agent gains nothing. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge with small limits and earns larger payments only after reliable service, instead of velvet-smooth instant full trust. This makes each fake identity costly while honest agents keep their history, turning a sybil flood from free into ruinous.
